hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case $f in *.sh) ;; *) head -n 1 "$f" | grep -qE '^#!.*[/ ](ba)?sh$' || exit 0 ;; esac; command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || exit 0; out=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" && shellcheck -x -f gcc "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
